posts.title: New Job Scaries
posts.description: I've just started a new software engineer job. For context, I've just come from why first dev where I was there for over 6 years. It's a relatively big change because the new company is very big, with lots of teams and totally different architecture, spread across different countries, and lots to get your head around.
